== CreateDatabase with a different user
refused: a Valkey database must have a user with the same name

== CreateDatabase for anywhere
refused: only the website containers can connect to Valkey

== SetDatabaseUser password
steps: Set password
long: false
valkey> AUTH default
valkey> ACL LIST
valkey> ACL SETUSER acme_x7k2_cache resetpass >PASSWORD
valkey> ACL SAVE
valkey> CLIENT KILL USER acme_x7k2_cache

== SetDatabaseUser create
refused: a Valkey database has one user, and only the website containers can connect

== DeleteDatabaseUser
refused: the user of a Valkey database goes with its database; remove the database

== Backup
refused: a backup and a staging copy do not include Valkey databases

== Restore
refused: a backup and a staging copy do not include Valkey databases

== databaseSizes
valkey acme_x7k2_cache 0
valkey acme_x7k2_jobs 0
valkey> AUTH default
valkey> ACL LIST
valkey> ACL LIST
valkey> INFO keyspace

== DeleteDatabase
steps: Remove database and user
long: false
valkey> AUTH default
valkey> ACL LIST
valkey> ACL DELUSER acme_x7k2_jobs
valkey> ACL SAVE
valkey> SELECT 2
valkey> FLUSHDB

== move secret
path: $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3/valkey.secret
"HEX48\n": <nil>
"short\n": the secret of the Valkey administrator is not valid
"POSTGRES_PASSWORD=00112233\n": the secret of the Valkey administrator is not valid
"": the secret of the Valkey administrator is not valid
unknown engine: line 1 of the secret of the mongodb superuser is not valid

  [Unit]
  Description=Cloudfactory Valkey database server 01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3
